algorithm: If n > 1, compute using the recurrence relation F_n = F_{n-1} + F_{n-2}
For Fibonacci polynomials, compute using F_n(x) = x*F_{n-1}(x) + F_{n-2}(x)
constraints: n must be an integer in the range 0..100
Fibonacci polynomials are computed with x = 1
output: The nth Fibonacci number or Fibonacci polynomial as an integer
purpose: Compute the nth Fibonacci number or Fibonacci polynomial.
